description: Angular component class for configuring a value chart widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, default data keys, output configuration, validators, and preview functions.

classes.name: ValueChartCardBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring a value chart card widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent, managing form controls, default data keys, output configuration, and UI logic.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the widget, e.g., temperature timeseries.

methods.name: defaultLatestDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default latest data keys for the widget.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data, setting up form controls.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the widget configuration based on form data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: updateLatestValues
methods.description: Updates the latest data keys in datasources based on source data key.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) are enabled.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states in the widget config.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a sample value string for preview purposes.
